title: Production mode requires a prior build step
statement: In Next.js 16.3.2, `next start` starts the application in production mode and requires the application to have been compiled with `next build` beforehand.
notes: Bears on QST-0021 as well as QST-0017: choosing production mode adds a build step between installation and startup, which the runtime lifecycle has to specify. It also means the operator can be in a state where the app is installed and cannot start — a failure mode `next dev` does not have.
